name: helpdesk_bootstrap_test_ops_mfa
description: S8b unit 01: the bootstrap, rooms, keyring and sign-in accounts of test_ops_mfa, before any S8b engine edit.

scenario.scenario_brief:
TEST: Ops multi-factor sign-in

A test floor for the second sign-in step (OPS_MFA_HELPDESK_PLAN.md, S8a). A lobby with a drop box, a wall port, an audit terminal and a cabinet; a floor with two PCs that ask for a six-digit code and three staff; a store room with a PC that sends a request to the owner's phone, one that asks for a number to be matched on the phone, one that asks for nothing extra, and three more staff. Nothing to solve.
scenario.endGoal: Test only: compare the sign-in with no second step, with a code, with a request to the owner and with a number to match.
